title: Pokreate
description: A NeoForge 1.21.1 tech and creature-collection experience merging the physics-based automation of Create: Aeronautics with the fully animated world of Cobblemon.
body:
# 🔴 Pokreate: Mechanics & Monsters

Welcome to **Pokreate**, a curated Minecraft 1.21.1 experience built on **NeoForge** that bridges the gap between complex industrial engineering and immersive creature collection. 

Whether you want to build automated Pokéball factories, assemble a fleet of flying airships to scout for Legendaries, or establish a high-tech ranch for your team, Pokreate gives you the tools to automate, explore, and conquer.

---

## ⚙️ FEATURE BREAKDOWN

### ✈️ Create: Aeronautics (The Next Era of Flight)
Take your factory to the skies. Powered by the groundbreaking **Sable physics engine**, this pack includes the newly released **Create Aeronautics**. 
* Build fully interactive, physics-compliant airships, cargo planes, and flying moving bases.
* Blocks retain their grid functionality while in mid-air—allowing you to automate and process materials while traveling.

### 🏭 Total Factory Automation (The Create Ecosystem)
Harness mechanical power and electricity with a deeply integrated suite of Create addons designed for ultimate automation capabilities:
* **Create: New Age:** Generate, store, and utilize electricity via kinetic rotation.
* **Create Crafts & Additions:** Convert rotational force into FE energy and hook up advanced wires.
* **Steam 'n' Rails:** Upgrade your logistics with custom train bogeys, advanced tracks, and signaling.
* **Enchantment Industry:** Liquidize experience points and fully automate your gear upgrading loops.
* **Copycats+ & Connected:** High-tier aesthetic choices to make your factories look incredibly clean.
* **Create Jetpacks:** Use pressurized air to safely fly around and construct massive multiblock structures.

### 🦅 Immersive Pokémon (Cobblemon Integration)
Experience Pokémon inside an open world designed for builders and engineers:
* **Catch & Battle:** Encounter hundreds of fully animated, open-world Pokémon across dozens of distinct biomes.
* **Industrial Ranching:** Use Create mechanical arms, belts, and pipes to assist with sorting resources, managing your ranches, or farming materials.

### 🏔️ Breathtaking World Generation
Exploration is entirely overhauled with cinematic, massive landscapes:
* **Tectonic & Lithostitched:** Massive cliffside ranges, smoother river networks, and deeper underground caverns to explore.
* **The Aether:** Step into the classic sky dimension, fully populated with unique biomes and flying Pokémon.

### ⚡ Peak Optimization & Shaders
Built from the ground up to ensure high frame rates even when rendering massive factories and flying airships:
* **Performance Suite:** Embedded with Sodium, Lithium, Indium, and FerriteCore to minimize memory usage and maximize FPS.
* **Shader Ready:** Built-in Iris support allows you to instantly toggle your favorite shader packs right out of the box.

---

## 🛠️ TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
* **Core Modloader:** NeoForge 1.21.1
* **Format:** `.mrpack` (All dependencies are automatically managed and pulled directly from Modrinth upon installation).
* **Recommended Allocated RAM:** 6GB - 8GB for optimal performance.
